name: Radiant Destiny — with the city's blessing, creatures of the chosen type also have vigilance
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "As long as you have the city's blessing, they also have vigilance" produced nothing, and no Ascend card read its blessing condition (the effect was always on). Game State has a City's Blessing toggle (hasCityBlessing); "they" is the subject of the sentence before, written out on a line of its own so the condition covers only the vigilance. Blessing on: Bears are 3/3 with vigilance.
